scope: All twenty already published original Float32 65x65 windows and all 49 dyadic tensor grids, three equally shared-C0-fitted families, 2940 new models. The existing windows and previous results are known, not a holdout or independently surveyed ground truth. Before this full protocol, four foundation tests observed affine reproduction, exact full ruled identity, and improvement for Manchester-centre homogeneous 4x8 and full-grid minus P1. Two further metric tests checked Manchester 1x2,4x8,8x4,64x64 homogeneous and repeating mixed families against independent GL5 and affine zero errors. No all-site fitting results have yet been observed.
structure: Keep the complete original grid XY, shared corners, native record topology, geoframe and GPR4 byte cost. P1 uses the already frozen diagonal-hybrid-v1 p1-local cell families; hybrid uses its hybrid-local families. Pure ruled uses the prior hybrid-source-v1 ruled candidate. Never reselect orientations/types after fitting. This is shared coefficient optimization of fixed spaces, not joint topology optimization, adaptive paper triangulation or a globally optimal hybrid basis.
